service.name: Wedding music in Boulder
service.serviceType: Live music for weddings in Boulder: ceremony guitarist, cocktail hour duo, band and DJ
service.description: Live wedding music in Boulder and Boulder County: an acoustic, jazz or Spanish guitarist for a ceremony on a lawn or a porch, a jazz or acoustic duo for the cocktail hour at a volume the neighbours never hear, a trio or the DJ for the reception indoors under the venue's sound policy, on one contract with sound included and a short Front Range travel line.

faqs.q: Do you play weddings in Boulder?
faqs.a: Yes, the whole day or any one part of it. Boulder is a short drive from Denver, so the music is quoted at the same fee a Denver wedding sees plus one short travel line, with no lodging. Chautauqua's Community House and Dining Hall, the Hotel Boulderado, the St Julien, Flagstaff House and Rembrandt Yard are the venues that come up most, along with backyards in the neighbourhoods around them.

faqs.q: What are Boulder's rules on wedding music outdoors?
faqs.a: Boulder has its own rules on evening sound, and every venue in it has a policy of its own on top. We honour caps and curfews as written: tell us the number your venue, HOA or rental agreement puts on evening sound and the cut-off it sets, and both go into the contract, including how the last set lands on the cut-off. A ceremony guitarist and a cocktail hour duo sit inside any of them on their own; a dance floor goes indoors.

faqs.q: Can we have a band at Chautauqua?
faqs.a: Yes, at the size the site allows. Chautauqua sits inside a residential historic district, so its sound policy is the first thing to ask for, and a duo through dinner or a trio indoors in the Community House is what most weddings there book. The ceremony on the lawn takes a guitarist with a small system that carries the officiant's microphone too, and the lot shares a trailhead that fills on summer evenings, so the load-in is planned around it.

faqs.q: Is a trio enough for a Boulder wedding reception?
faqs.a: For most Boulder venues, yes, and it is often the biggest size the venue allows. A trio of guitar, bass and drums fills a floor without a stage in 12 by 8 feet on one dedicated circuit, and the DJ takes the same sound system when the band is done. The Boulderado and the St Julien ballrooms take a quartet, and we'll say so when a date wants four pieces.

faqs.q: How far ahead should we book wedding musicians in Boulder?
faqs.a: Boulder's short list of venues books its Saturdays a year or more out, and couples in wedding forums report booking music after the venue and before most of the rest of the list. Tell us the date and the venue and we'll come back quickly with an answer, and with the venue's sound rules checked.
